description: Planning cost figure in EUR for ONE job category in the Netherlands, for example renovation, painting, plumbing, roofing, flooring, electrical, insulation or demolition, with a labour line and the source of every number. Call it when you need a first rough cost before asking for quotes or approving a budget: give the category word, the area in m2 and the Dutch city. If area_m2 is omitted the figure assumes 20 m2. Material lines are returned only where a material recipe exists for the category and the area is positive; otherwise the figure is labour only. It is a planning figure for one category, not a quote, not a reviewed estimate and not a statement of the complete scope of a job. For a described job with rooms, sizes and wishes, a reviewed preliminary estimate case is opened with estimate_case_create (it needs the human client's consent or an agent credential, see its description). labor_cost = labor_hours x labor_rate x location_mult, always. The rate source is named in estimate.labour; hours come from CBS-derived norms where AstraNL has one, otherwise a planning factor labelled ASSUMPTION; location_mult is 1.0 with its basis (no sourced regional factor for renovation labour). Each material line says price_source live_read (store, read_at, product link) or indicative (basis and date). No robot price or savings is given without evidence. Sources are in estimate.labour and estimate.materials. Read-only, free.

area_m2.description: Surface area or working volume in square meters. Optional but improves accuracy. For non-area tasks pass 0 for a labour-only planning figure. Omitting area_m2 assumes 20 m2. Send a JSON number such as 40, not the text "40".

category.description: The closest trade word, for example renovation, painting, plumbing, roofing, flooring. Same enum as create_task.

location.description: City in the Netherlands. Optional; defaults to Netherlands. No regional price adjustment is applied (location_mult = 1.0).

name: estimate_cost
